verses.en: Then Job answered and said,
verses.pt: Então Jó respondeu, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Job answered,
verses.en_bbe: And Job made answer and said,

verses.en: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.
verses.pt: Tenho ouvido muitas coisas como essas; todos vós sois consoladores molestos.
verses.en_web: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
verses.en_bbe: Such things have frequently come to my ears: you are comforters who only give trouble.

verses.en: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?
verses.pt: Não terão fim essas palavras de vento? Ou que é o que te provoca, para assim responderes?
verses.en_web: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
verses.en_bbe: May words which are like the wind be stopped? or what is troubling you to make answer to them?

verses.en: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.
verses.pt: Eu também poderia falar como vós falais, se vós estivésseis em meu lugar; eu poderia amontoar palavras contra vós, e contra vós menear a minha cabeça;
verses.en_web: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,
verses.en_bbe: It would not be hard for me to say such things if your souls were in my soul's place; joining words together against you, and shaking my head at you:

verses.en: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.
verses.pt: poderia fortalecer-vos com a minha boca, e a consolação dos meus lábios poderia mitigar a vossa dor.
verses.en_web: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.
verses.en_bbe: I might give you strength with my mouth, and not keep back the comfort of my lips.

verses.en: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.pt: Ainda que eu fale, a minha dor naõ se mitiga; e embora me cale, qual é o meu alívio?
verses.en_web: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?
verses.en_bbe: If I say what is in my mind, my pain becomes no less: and if I keep quiet, how much of it goes from me?

verses.en: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.
verses.pt: Mas agora, ó Deus, me deixaste exausto; assolaste toda a minha companhia.
verses.en_web: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made desolate all my company.
verses.en_bbe: But now he has overcome me with weariness and fear, and I am in the grip of all my trouble.

verses.en: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.
verses.pt: Tu me emagreceste, e isso constitui uma testemunha contra mim; contra mim se levanta a minha magreza, e o meu rosto testifica contra mim.
verses.en_web: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.
verses.en_bbe: It has come up as a witness against me, and the wasting of my flesh makes answer to my face.

verses.en: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.
verses.pt: Na sua ira ele me despedaçou, e me perseguiu; rangeu os dentes contra mim; o meu adversário aguça os seus olhos contra mim.
verses.en_web: He has torn me in his wrath, and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.
verses.en_bbe: I am broken by his wrath, and his hate has gone after me; he has made his teeth sharp against me: my haters are looking on me with cruel eyes;

verses.en: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.
verses.pt: Os homens abrem contra mim a boca; com desprezo me ferem nas faces, e contra mim se ajuntam à uma.
verses.en_web: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.
verses.en_bbe: Their mouths are open wide against me; the blows of his bitter words are falling on my face; all of them come together in a mass against me.

verses.en: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.
verses.pt: Deus me entrega ao ímpio, nas mãos dos iníquos me faz cair.
verses.en_web: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
verses.en_bbe: God gives me over to the power of sinners, sending me violently into the hands of evil-doers.

verses.en: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.
verses.pt: Descansado estava eu, e ele me quebrantou; e pegou-me pelo pescoço, e me despedaçou; colocou-me por seu alvo;
verses.en_web: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.
verses.en_bbe: I was in comfort, but I have been broken up by his hands; he has taken me by the neck, shaking me to bits; he has put me up as a mark for his arrows.

verses.en: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.
verses.pt: cercam-me os seus flecheiros. Atravessa-me os rins, e não me poupa; derrama o meu fel pela terra.
verses.en_web: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my gall on the ground.
verses.en_bbe: His bowmen come round about me; their arrows go through my body without mercy; my life is drained out on the earth.

verses.en: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.
verses.pt: Quebranta-me com golpe sobre golpe; arremete contra mim como um guerreiro.
verses.en_web: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs on me like a giant.
verses.en_bbe: I am broken with wound after wound; he comes rushing on me like a man of war.

verses.en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.
verses.pt: Sobre a minha pele cosi saco, e deitei a minha glória no pó.
verses.en_web: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.
verses.en_bbe: I have made haircloth the clothing of my skin, and my horn is rolled in the dust.

verses.en: My face is foul with weeping, and my eyelids is the shadow of death;
verses.pt: O meu rosto todo está inflamado de chorar, e há sombras escuras sobre as minhas pálpebras,
verses.en_web: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids.
verses.en_bbe: My face is red with weeping, and my eyes are becoming dark;

verses.en: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.
verses.pt: embora não haja violência nas minhas maos, e seja pura a minha oração.
verses.en_web: Although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
verses.en_bbe: Though my hands have done no violent acts, and my prayer is clean.

verses.en: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.
verses.pt: ó terra, não cubras o meu sangue, e não haja lugar em que seja abafado o meu clamor!
verses.en_web: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
verses.en_bbe: O earth, let not my blood be covered, and let my cry have no resting-place!

verses.en: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.
verses.pt: Eis que agora mesmo a minha testemunha está no céu, e o meu fiador nas alturas.
verses.en_web: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.
verses.en_bbe: Even now my witness is in heaven, and the supporter of my cause is on high.

verses.en: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.
verses.pt: Os meus amigos zombam de mim; mas os meus olhos se desfazem em lágrimas diante de Deus,
verses.en_web: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,
verses.en_bbe: My friends make sport of me; to God my eyes are weeping,

verses.en: Oh that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!
verses.pt: para que ele defenda o direito que o homem tem diante de Deus e o que o filho do homem tem perante, o seu proximo.
verses.en_web: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!
verses.en_bbe: So that he may give decision for a man in his cause with God, and between a son of man and his neighbour.

verses.en: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.
verses.pt: Pois quando houver decorrido poucos anos, eu seguirei o caminho por onde não tornarei.
verses.en_web: For when a few years have come, I shall go the way of no return.
verses.en_bbe: For in a short time I will take the journey from which I will not come back.
